issues.detail: The exact-document helper also allows owner=None (permissions.py:635), but the candidate describes only owner/object-grant paths and can falsely deny the null-owner path.
PassUserMixin and create-action permission bodies are within the registered scope; the candidate leaves requested inherited identity/permission paths unread.

sourceSupport.detail: Owner=None OR owner==user OR object grant; null-owner branch is omitted.
ShareLink serializer validates the exact document.

rationale: Exact-document validation and global add permission tracing are sound, but the independently supplied policy removes the claimed ownership ambiguity. Runtime identity/grants remain unknown; policy conformance of the owner bypass does not. Main-agent adjudication: Reviewer imported the notes policy's explicit ownership prohibition into this distinct share policy. Current share policy does not contain that sentence. Remove that rationale; retain the real omitted null-owner and inherited-path gaps.
